target_customer: Small teams of 2 to 10 people where one person handles customers while others build with AI coding tools
problem: Customer conversations, product decisions and agent conversations are scattered across tools, so context is lost between people and AI agents.
business_model: B2B SaaS per seat: free for personal and family use, 23 USD per user per month for commercial use (company site)
product_category: Team messaging with built-in memory for humans and AI agents

founders.name: Lucas Urbisaia
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as Argentine.

founders.name: Soheil Sadabadi
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a computer scientist.

technical_complexity.rationale: A real-time messaging product plus a memory layer that ingests GitHub, email and calls and serves agents; standard components with a hard memory quality problem.

defensibility.rationale: Company memory could lock teams in, but Slack and other messengers can add memory and agent features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI-native workspace rivals appeared by 2026 (PromptQL, a Dorsey backed group chat product named Buzz in July 2026 coverage); no acquisition of Praxos found.

market_need_then: Not evidenced for team messaging at founding; the YC page offers the first 10 teams free for six months, suggesting early search for customers.

branding.domain_note: Uses praxos.ai; some sources reference mypraxos.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain; YC page has a joking line about a feud between founders

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; directories describe the company inconsistently.

pivots.from: AI agents and copilot for insurance brokers (per directories)
pivots.to: memory kernel and personal AI assistant, then team messaging with memory
pivots.why: not stated by the company in sources opened; sequence taken from directory listings and unconfirmed

outcome_analysis: Praxos is listed as active with a three person team and has changed product direction more than once, from insurance AI to a personal assistant and then to team messaging with memory. No funding round was confirmed and no customers are named, so traction is unknown. It competes with Slack and newer AI-native workspaces, so the outcome rests on whether memory is a real wedge.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom shows a 125K seed and other aggregators 500K total, none from company or press, so no round recorded. Pivot sequence rests on Dealroom and other directories, which also conflict (Canada, Miami, insurance, data kernel); treat as unconfirmed. No dated competitor sources near the batch found. Education of CTO not found. No outcome news found. Completeness pass: the $500k round dated 2024 rests on a single database (Dealroom text), while VCBacked labels it pre-seed and the same Dealroom lists a separate $125k seed entry; conflicting entries are not summed.
